clauses.title: Section I - Accidental damage
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the Insured against Loss or Damage to the vehicle insured hereunder ... (vi) by accidental external means.
clauses.note: Covers collision, impact, hitting a pole, wall, another vehicle, being hit by another vehicle, front or rear body damage from an accident.

clauses.title: Section I - Fire
clauses.text: (i) by fire explosion self-ignition or lightning.

clauses.title: Section I - Malicious act
clauses.note: Covers vandalism such as scratched paint or broken glass by a third person.

clauses.title: Section I Exclusion (a) - Mechanical breakdown, wear and tear
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable to make any payment in respect of: (a) consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown failures or breakages.
clauses.note: Engine noise, engine failure, gearbox, clutch, electrical faults not caused by the accident impact are excluded.

clauses.title: Section I Exclusion (b) - Tyres and tubes
clauses.text: Damage to tyres and tubes is excluded unless the vehicle insured is damaged at the same time, in which case the liability of the Company shall be limited to 50% of the cost of replacement.

clauses.title: Section I Exclusion (c) - Intoxication
clauses.text: Any accidental Loss or Damage suffered whilst the Insured or any person driving the vehicle with the knowledge and consent of the Insured is under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs.

clauses.title: Section I - Depreciation by material
clauses.text: Rate of depreciation for parts replaced: rubber, nylon, plastic parts, tyres and tubes, batteries 50%; fibre glass components 30%; all parts made of glass nil. Painting: depreciation 50% on material cost only; in a consolidated painting bill, material is taken as 25% of total painting charges.

clauses.title: Section I - Depreciation on metal and other parts by vehicle age
clauses.text: Not exceeding 6 months nil; 6 months to 1 year 5%; 1 to 2 years 10%; 2 to 3 years 15%; 3 to 4 years 25%; 4 to 5 years 35%; 5 to 10 years 40%; exceeding 10 years 50%.

clauses.title: Constructive total loss
clauses.text: The insured Private Car shall be treated as a CTL if the aggregate cost of retrieval and/or repair of the Private Car exceeds 75% of the IDV of the Private Car.

clauses.title: Compulsory deductible
clauses.text: Each claim under Section I is subject to a compulsory deductible as specified in the Schedule, plus any voluntary deductible opted.
clauses.note: Standard: Rs 1,000 for cars up to 1500 cc, Rs 2,000 above 1500 cc.

clauses.title: General Exception 1 - Geography
clauses.text: Loss, damage or liability occurring outside the Geographical Area is not covered.

clauses.title: General Exception 3(a) - Limitations as to use
clauses.text: Any accidental loss or damage whilst the vehicle is being used otherwise than in accordance with the Limitations as to Use (e.g. hire or reward, racing).

clauses.title: General Exception 3(b) - Driver
clauses.text: Any accidental loss or damage whilst the vehicle is being driven by any person other than a Driver as stated in the Driver's clause (must hold a valid licence).

clauses.title: Condition 1 - Notice of claim
clauses.text: Notice shall be given in writing to the Company immediately upon the occurrence of any accidental Loss or Damage, with full particulars.

clauses.title: Condition - Repair authorisation
clauses.text: The Insured may authorise repair only if the estimated cost does not exceed Rs 500 and the Company is furnished forthwith with a detailed estimate of the cost of repairs;
clauses.note: Otherwise the Company's surveyor assesses first.

clauses.title: Add-on: Zero depreciation (insurer-specific endorsement)
clauses.text: If the Zero Depreciation add-on is purchased, depreciation on replaced parts is not deducted, subject to the add-on's own limits.
clauses.note: Paraphrase of a typical add-on, not standard policy wording; check the actual add-on terms.
